title: Chapter 218: Loyal Soul Hall And Transmission Hall
content:
Chapter 218: Loyal Soul Hall And Transmission Hall

The condition for upgrading the second-level barracks to the third-level requires a third-level village. Wang Shuo has already met this condition. However, the energy crystals for upgrading one barracks require 200,000.

This made Wang Shuo hesitate. There are too many places to spend money now, and they are all tens of thousands.

It hurts Wang Shuo a little.

Gritting his teeth, Wang Shuo still upgraded all four barracks to the third level.

And upgrading to the fourth level requires upgrading to a town.

This made Wang Shuo worried, because now he has no idea how to upgrade the town.

At this time, Wang Shuo found that the number of military transfer certificates that can be purchased for each barracks has increased.

The cavalry battalion, archer battalion, and shield battalion can purchase 300 transfer certificates every day.

In the infantry battalion, the number of scrolls is also 300, but it is the total number of transfer certificates for all military types.

Wang Shuo thought that maybe this thing can be sold in the future.

So he bought all the transfer certificates.

Then, he went to the material exchange center and exchanged 50 tools.

These two things almost became Wang Shuo's daily routine.

Wang Shuo found Gong Zheng and handed him all the shield soldier job transfer certificates, and at the same time, allocated these 50 people to him.

Gong Zheng immediately used the shield soldier job transfer certificate, but it was unsuccessful.

Wang Shuo immediately thought of a "professional forgotten scroll".

After Gong Zheng used it, he could really change his job to become a shield soldier again.

In an instant, Gong Zheng's momentum suddenly changed, as majestic as a mountain.

"Thank you, Lord, for your help." Gong Zheng hurriedly clasped his fists, with a smile on his face. It can be seen that he likes it very much.

Wang Shuo nodded. It seems that Gong Zheng's soul seal has also loosened a lot.

There are still two special buildings that have not been used.

[Zhonghun Hall: It can improve the loyalty of the territory. ]

[Chuangong Hall: Put martial arts skills into it, which can be practiced by many people. Adding energy crystals can increase the speed of practice. ]

There is too little introduction to Zhonghun Hall, and Wang Shuo is confused.

The Transmission Hall made Wang Shuo happy.

He immediately came to the outside of the Lord's Mansion, selected a vacant lot, and placed two buildings on the ground.

[Do you want to build the Loyal Soul Hall? ]

"Yes."

[Do you want to build the Transmission Hall? ]

"Yes."

After completing the process, the two magnificent and solemn palaces were soon completed.

Wang Shuo walked into the Transmission Hall. In the hall, there were 40 cushions laid out in order.

Upstairs, there were also separate small rooms.

There were 10 on the second floor and 2 on the third floor.

Wang Shuo came to the third floor, and the door of one of the rooms was written with the word "Control Room".

Pushing the door open, a bookshelf-like thing came into view.

There was also an operating table next to it.

Touch it lightly, and an operating interface popped up.

Wang Shuo was already very familiar with this operating interface.

After trying it a few times, Wang Shuo figured out the principle.

You only need to put the secret manual of the skill into the bookshelf, and you can practice in the corresponding room or hall.

In a drawer below the operation interface, put in an energy crystal to activate an acceleration effect that improves the cultivation method.

The lowest selectable multiple is 1x, and the highest is 10x.

Just looking at the consumption of energy crystals.

Wang Shuo's enthusiasm was reduced by more than half.

Turning on 1x, 100 energy crystals are consumed per minute.

Turning on 10x, 10,000 energy crystals are consumed per minute.

The hall needs to double again.

Wang Shuo calculated.

Turning on 10x speed, it will take 14.4 million energy crystals in one day.

I can't afford it, I really can't afford it!

The consumption of energy crystals in this Transmission Hall is too terrible.
